hint.restart: Off the solution path. Restart to continue.
hud.controls: Arrows Move · Shift Dig · Ctrl Pour · Z Undo · H Hint · Esc Pause
extra.rule.push.name: Push and step up
extra.rule.push.text: Walk into one crate to push it. Crate chains cannot move. Step up one tile when both spaces above are clear.
extra.rule.ladder.name: Ladders
extra.rule.ladder.text: You stay in a ladder. Up enters the rung above; Down goes lower. Ladders do not support crates.
extra.rule.pour.name: Pour sand
extra.rule.pour.text: Ctrl and Left or Right pours one bag into a free tile. Pour beside a wall or into a pit for a reliable step.
extra.rule.plate_door.name: Plates and doors
extra.rule.plate_door.text: Press every plate with the same sign to open its door. You, crates and sand press plates. Occupied doors stay open.
extra.rule.fall.name: Losing support
extra.rule.fall.text: You and crates fall without support. Crates can stack. There is no fall damage.
chapter.unavailable: Not available yet. Play M01–M07 in Basics.
level.Q01.title: Blast a Path
level.Q01.discovery: A higher blast breaks the wall while leaving the cracked ledge under the crate intact.
level.Q01.hint.1: The crate and socket are on the upper ledge. The rock beneath the crate is cracked too.
level.Q01.hint.2: A higher blast breaks the wall but spares the support. A low blast breaks both.
level.Q01.hint.3: Walk to the ladder, climb one rung, then blast right. Keep the ledge beneath the crate and push it into the socket.
level.Q02.title: Blasts Cross Walls
level.Q02.discovery: Bedrock stops you, but a blast can remove the crate’s support on the other side. Match its height, then climb out.
level.Q02.hint.1: The shaft beneath the crate leads to its socket. The flag above the left ladder is your exit.
level.Q02.hint.2: Bedrock does not shield the cracked support. Place the blast at the same height as that support.
level.Q02.hint.3: Climb to the support, blast right through the wall, climb once more, then go left to the flag.
level.Q03.title: Light It, Then Wait
level.Q03.discovery: Only the unbroken fuse that bends toward the exit can open it. The closer fuse ends in a dead end.
level.Q03.hint.1: There are two fuses. Trace which cracked rock each one reaches before using your only bomb.
level.Q03.hint.2: The right fuse bends upward toward the exit. The short fuse on the left only reaches a closed pocket.
level.Q03.hint.3: Light the right fuse. Cross below, climb the right ladder once, then step up to the exit.
level.Q04.title: Slowly Does It
level.Q04.discovery: Gravel held in the hopper makes a crossing. Break the hopper floor first and it settles too deep to reach the far ledge.
level.Q04.hint.1: There is cracked rock both above and below the hopper. One holds the gravel; the other is the hopper floor.
level.Q04.hint.2: The bin floor is within reach from the ladder's foot. Break it and the gravel sinks too low; keep it to bridge the gap.
level.Q04.hint.3: Climb to the upper ledge and blast right. Let the gravel settle, then cross to the flag.
level.G01.title: A Drop Opens the Way
level.G01.discovery: Marked rock cannot be dug. Open the plug above it so the acid drips down and eats it, then drop into its place and dig the earth beside it.
level.G01.hint.1: The exit is behind a marked rock and a block of earth. The rock cannot be dug.
level.G01.hint.2: One tile of acid sits right above the rock, behind a plug. Release the acid and wait before you go down.
level.G01.hint.3: Left four times and dig left. Step left into the shaft, dig left, then walk left twice to the exit.
level.G02.title: The Same Mark Dissolves
level.G02.discovery: Judge by the carving, not the colour: the dark red M carries the same mark as the pale L and is eaten just the same. The unmarked dark R does not lose a single grain.
level.G02.hint.1: The two tiles of acid can be spent only once: open a plug and all of it runs into that shaft.
level.G02.hint.2: The left shaft holds a dark red, marked M. The right shaft holds pale L sitting on a dark, unmarked R.
level.G02.hint.3: Walk left into the acid pool, one more step left, dig the left plug. Drop into the left shaft, dig left, walk left twice.
level.G03.title: Smoke Rises
level.G03.discovery: Smoke rises through an open ceiling shaft by itself. Stay outside the smoke chamber, then return to the right ladder and reach the exit.
level.G03.hint.1: There are two goal lights: the smoke collector above and the exit at the upper right.
level.G03.hint.2: Dig open the smoke chamber's ceiling, but stay on the right. The smoke will rise without you.
level.G03.hint.3: Go left four times and dig left. Return right three times, climb up three times, then go left to the exit.
level.G04.title: Fog Sinks
level.G04.discovery: Fog sinks through the low opening into the dry collector shaft. You must use the right ladder; digging the shortcut underfoot traps you in a water pit.
level.G04.hint.1: The collector is in the left shaft, and the exit is beside the right ladder. The water pit between them has no way out.
level.G04.hint.2: Open the low outlet into the dry shaft and let the fog sink. Take the right ladder and leave the floor plug alone.
level.G04.hint.3: Go left three times and dig left. Return right three times, climb down three times, then go left to the exit.
level.G05.title: The Disappearing Plug
level.G05.discovery: The plug expires and the sand falls during one switch sequence. The full collector raises the lift only once, so load the box before pulling the switch.
level.G05.hint.1: The sand collector under the plug controls the lift. The lift has no box on it yet.
level.G05.hint.2: Load the box first. The plug will expire and release the sand during the switch sequence.
level.G05.hint.3: Push the crate left four times, walk right four times back to the lever, press Up.
level.G06.title: Water the Vine
level.G06.discovery: The water can drain into either shaft, but only the right shaft has a vine root. Open the right plug from outside the pool to grow a ladder to the exit.
level.G06.hint.1: Only the right shaft has a vine root. The exit is above that shaft.
level.G06.hint.2: Do not enter the pool and dig the left plug. Water sent into the empty left shaft cannot grow the right vine.
level.G06.hint.3: Go left three times and dig left. Step left onto the grown vine, climb up three times, then go left to the exit.
level.G08.title: Bouncing Mushroom
level.G08.discovery: A mushroom launches you two tiles only when you fall onto it. The left mushroom reaches the high ladder; the equally deep right shaft has no bounce.
level.G08.hint.1: Only the left shaft has a mushroom, and the exit ladder is above it.
level.G08.hint.2: The mushroom responds to a fall. Follow the upper ledge to the left shaft instead of climbing down the right ladder.
level.G08.hint.3: Left five times to bounce; climb twice, then go left to the exit.
level.G09.title: Seesaw
level.G09.discovery: A falling load launches the opposite side only once. Open the door in the wooden box's path first, then go around above the iron box and push it onto the right end.
level.G09.hint.1: A door blocks the wooden box's launch path. Its switch is under your feet; the iron box must be pushed from the other side.
level.G09.hint.2: Open the launch door first. Enter the ladder on your right and use the upper passage to get behind the iron box.
level.G09.hint.3: Up, Right, Up 2, Right 3, Down 2, Left 2; then Right 2 to the exit.
level.G10.title: Sand on the Seesaw
level.G10.discovery: The earth blocking the launch path is also your only bag of sand. Dig it out, carry it to the far pressure plate, and use sand instead of yourself to load the seesaw.
level.G10.hint.1: Your bag is empty, but there is a tile of earth in the wooden box's launch path.
level.G10.hint.2: Carry the dug sand across the upper path. The far plate opens your starting shore's inlet.
level.G10.hint.3: Dig left, go up twice, right four times, down twice, and left twice. Pour left, then go right twice to the exit.
level.F01.title: Wood Burns Away
level.F01.discovery: The crate is fireproof. Burn away its wooden supports, and it drops into the socket to become a step across the pit.
level.F01.hint.1: The socket is directly below the wooden supports. The fireproof crate will survive the flames.
level.F01.hint.2: Go to the lever on the left first. Burn away the supports to release the crate.
level.F01.hint.3: Move left once and press Up, then move right six times. The crate in the socket gives you a step across the pit.
level.F02.title: Freeze a Bridge
level.F02.discovery: Water cannot hold you up. Freeze just its top row to make a lasting bridge from the safety of the ladder.
level.F02.hint.1: The ladder on the left lets you return to the bank. The far bank is too high to climb from the bottom of the pool.
level.F02.hint.2: Find the frost lever on the left first. Its outline covers only the top row of water, which can become solid support.
level.F02.hint.3: Move left once and press Up, then move right six times across the ice to the exit. There is no need to hurry.
level.F03.title: Heat Melts Ice
level.F03.discovery: Melting ice also removes its support. Push the crate into the socket first, then return to melt the ice and fill the collector.
level.F03.hint.1: The heat vent points at the ice beneath the crate. Both the socket and the collector must light up.
level.F03.hint.2: Push the crate off the ice and into the socket on the right before returning to the lever.
level.F03.hint.3: Right 4 to fill the socket; Left 4 to the lever; Up to melt the ice into the collector.
level.F04.title: Explosions Ignite Too
level.F04.discovery: An explosion only ignites wood close to its centre. Place the blast beneath the barrier from the recess, and let the fire spread upward to open the passage.
level.F04.hint.1: The barrier stands on bedrock. The far end of the recess lets you place a blast directly beneath it.
level.F04.hint.2: Save your only charge until you reach the end of the recess. The ignition area extends only halfway across the blast radius.
level.F04.hint.3: Right 3; bomb right; let the wood burn; Right 4 to exit.
level.F07.title: One Push Across the Ice
level.F07.discovery: The socket will not stop a sliding crate. Go over the top, push from the left, and leave the packed earth on the right as a brake.
level.F07.hint.1: The socket is in the middle of the ice. The packed earth just beyond it can stop the crate in the right place.
level.F07.hint.2: Take the ladders across the upper passage to reach the left side of the crate. Leave the earth block where it is.
level.F07.hint.3: Up 2, Left 7, Down 2, Right 2. The earth block stops the sliding crate in its socket.
level.F08.title: The Gust Vent
level.F08.discovery: The wind cannot move the iron crate. Drop it into place first: it will stop the wooden crate in its socket and give you a step toward the left ladder.
level.F08.hint.1: The wind moves the wooden crate but leaves the iron crate alone. The two sockets below need both crates.
level.F08.hint.2: Push the iron crate left into the socket below. It will stop the wooden crate and give you a step toward the left ladder.
level.F08.hint.3: Move left three times, climb up twice, then go left five times to the exit. Do not climb the right ladder first.
level.F09.title: Freeze a Sliding Path
level.F09.discovery: Freeze the water first so a pile of sand can stay on top as a brake. The same ice then carries the sliding iron crate to the socket before the end of the track.
level.F09.hint.1: The socket is in the middle of the track, two blocks from the right wall. You need a brake just beyond the socket.
level.F09.hint.2: Freeze the water before pouring sand beside the right wall. Once the brake is in place, go around to the left of the iron crate.
level.F09.hint.3: Up, Right 2, pour right; Left 3, Up, Left 2; Right 3 to slide the crate.
level.Q07.title: One Push, Full Roll
level.Q07.discovery: Load the crate from the ledge before going down to push the cart. An empty cart sent to the far wall cannot return for its cargo.
level.Q07.hint.1: The crate is above an empty cart. The far end of the track sits against the right wall.
level.Q07.hint.2: One side push sends the cart to the end of its track. Load it before sending it away.
level.Q07.hint.3: Load the cart from above. Step left, climb down twice, then go right twice to push it.
level.Q08.title: Solid in the Lamplight
level.Q08.discovery: Reach the crate from the other side, push it onto the lit bridge, then step away so it drops into the deep socket.
level.Q08.hint.1: You start to the crate’s right. Pushing left drops it into a ladder shaft with no room to get behind it.
level.Q08.hint.2: Take the right ladder down and the left ladder back up. Your lamp must be within two tiles to keep the bridge solid.
level.Q08.hint.3: From the left ladder, push right twice onto the bridge. Step left once to darken the bridge and let the crate fall.
level.Q09.title: Crate Within a Crate
level.Q09.discovery: Peel both outer layers on the ledge before dropping the crate. Following it down to finish blasting leaves you unable to reach the flag.
level.Q09.hint.1: The crate has three layers. The small-crate symbol by the socket means it only accepts the innermost one.
level.Q09.hint.2: Each blast removes one layer. You can follow the crate down to blast again, but you cannot climb back to the exit flag.
level.Q09.hint.3: Blast right twice, push the crate into the shaft, then step left twice to the flag.
level.Q10.title: Blast the Track
level.Q10.discovery: Park the empty cart below the hanging crate. One blast can remove the crate’s support and the track blockage together, so the cart catches its load.
level.Q10.hint.1: The rock under the crate and the rock on the track are both next to the same possible blast point.
level.Q10.hint.2: Push the empty cart first; it stops beneath the crate. Blasting from above first drops the load too low to catch.
level.Q10.hint.3: Go down the left ladder and push the cart. Walk up to its side, blast right, then push again to deliver the crate.
level.E04.title: Gravel Breaks the Bridge
level.E04.discovery: One tile of gravel alone fills the bridge exactly. Push the crate onto the bridge first, then blast the support so the gravel lands on the crate: only then is it overloaded and the crate drops into the slot below.
level.E04.hint.1: The bridge carries one load. A tile of gravel hangs above it and a crate waits beside it.
level.E04.hint.2: One tile of gravel only fills the bridge; the crate is the extra weight that breaks it.
level.E04.hint.3: Push the crate onto the bridge, step back to the ladder, climb once and blast right. Then climb up and go left.
level.E05.title: Slide into the Cart
level.E05.discovery: The ice sends the crate off the high ledge in one push. Park the cart below first so it catches the crate at the socket’s height.
level.E05.hint.1: The ice ends over a deep shaft, with a socket partway down. The cart can support the crate just beneath it.
level.E05.hint.2: Park the cart at the far end first. It cannot lift a crate that has already fallen below.
level.E05.hint.3: Climb down three rungs and push the cart once. Step back, climb up three rungs, then walk right three times to slide the crate.
level.E06.title: Let the Wind Launch You
level.E06.discovery: Stand on the opposite end before releasing the wind. The blown crate falls onto the seesaw and launches you onto the high ledge.
level.E06.hint.1: Both switches open the wind gate. Only a fresh falling load can launch the opposite end.
level.E06.hint.2: The near switch drops the crate too soon. A resting load cannot launch you later.
level.E06.hint.3: Down 3, Right 5, Up. After the launch, walk right twice.
extra.controls.bomb: Hold B with a direction, or drag a bomb to an adjacent tile.
level.E01.title: Open the Dam
level.E01.discovery: The door is also the dam of the acid pool. With the crate on the plate the door stays open: the acid drops onto the soft rock, and you follow it down the same doorway.
level.E01.hint.1: One tile of acid sits right above the door; below the door a shaft leads to the soft rock.
level.E01.hint.2: The door opens only while someone stands on the plate. Let the crate hold it for you.
level.E01.hint.3: Push the crate left twice onto the plate, walk right four times through the door into the shaft, dig right, walk right twice.
level.E02.title: Out of Light, Into the Portal
level.E02.discovery: Step away from the bridge and the crate falls onto the portal below, sending it straight into the distant high socket.
level.E02.hint.1: The high socket shares a triangle portal. Its partner is at the bottom of the shaft beneath the light bridge.
level.E02.hint.2: Get to the crate’s left side first. While your lamp lights the bridge, the crate cannot reach the portal below.
level.E02.hint.3: Climb around the crate; push right twice, then step left once to darken the bridge.
level.E03.title: Meltwater for the Vine
level.E03.discovery: Melting the ice waters a vine that reaches the high exit, but it also removes the ground beneath the crate. Save the crate first.
level.E03.hint.1: The vine root lies below the ice, under the crate. It can grow a ladder to the high flag.
level.E03.hint.2: Fill the crate socket first. Then turn the same supporting ice into water for the vine.
level.E03.hint.3: Right 4; Left 3; Up at the heat switch. Go right to the vine, climb twice, then head right.
extra.chapter.review_blurb: Cross-chapter review: make one mechanism change how another works.
